criteria.notes: Selection shows the authored animated 2D route before the complete 3D journey, with a separate QR continuation action.
The Studio fixture retains its artwork, polygon styling, labels, marker, route styling, and floor geometry in every state.
The map-first directory, destination rail, route controls, and focused QR modal form a specific kiosk-to-phone experience.
Primary prompt, directory rows, route action, QR instructions, and destination status remain legible across Full HD captures.
Dark, light, and custom shell variants preserve clear control contrast without recoloring the authored map.
Long venue and welcome copy remain contained without obscuring search, filters, results, or route actions.
All ten captures keep the map dominant while directory and detail rails remain balanced; the QR dialog has a clear scan target.
Studio artwork and the canonical viewer render cleanly in 2D, normal 3D, exploded journey, theme, and modal states.
This remains the sole canonical Wayfinding reference and now uniquely teaches a semantic mobile route handoff.
